about_variants:
I build agentic artificial intelligence systems where verification matters, not prompt demos. My work spans generative media pipelines (ComicMainEngine), budget-gated language model scene direction (Procedural City), and research reproduction (BeamDojo with Isaac Lab locomotion), all connected through a multi-repo operations dashboard (Venture Fleet Control Plane) with phase gates, spend tracking, and schema-backed evaluations.

Education: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science, Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur; Master of Science in Computer Science, University of Massachusetts Amherst. Before grad school I spent three years at Mastercard shipping payment-card-industry-compliant microservices, web services for Enhanced Currency Conversion (around 20% latency reduction), tokenization key-block compliance, and Java gateway modernization. At UMass Biomedical Natural Language Processing lab I worked on language model diagnosis ranking on clinical text.

I'm looking for applied artificial intelligence and agent engineer roles where production discipline (evaluations, provenance, cost ceilings) meets fast iteration. Open to backend-heavy generative artificial intelligence platform teams too.

Agent engineer with a backend foundation: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science at Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, Master of Science in Computer Science at University of Massachusetts Amherst, and three years at Mastercard building high-volume payment interfaces. I ship FastAPI services with structured outputs, per-call usage accounting, and hard spend ceilings, then prove quality with automated evaluation gates instead of manual review loops.

Recent builds: ComicMainEngine (end-to-end generative comic pipeline with vision-language model rubric gates), Procedural City (92-phase 3D pipeline with language model scene director and schema validation), and BeamDojo (Isaac Lab locomotion reproduction on Lambda graphics processing unit). Venture Fleet Control Plane is my steward dashboard syncing status, phases, and expenses across ventures.

Interested in roles building tool-using agents, multi-step workflows, and evaluation-first language model products, not robotics-first positioning unless the team wants simulation-to-real research.

I design language-model-powered products like backend systems: schemas, job queues, provenance logs, and cost controls from day one. Portfolio focus is agentic generative media and operations tooling - ComicMainEngine, Procedural City, BeamDojo - backed by a live command center that syncs venture state across repos.

Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science (Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur) and Master of Science in Computer Science (University of Massachusetts Amherst). Mastercard taught me how to ship under compliance pressure (payment card industry standards, tokenization, Enhanced Currency Conversion latency). UMass Biomedical Natural Language Processing lab taught me how to benchmark clinical language models with recall metrics. I combine both when building agents that must be auditable and affordable at scale.

Seeking applied artificial intelligence and agentic engineering roles (and selective artificial intelligence backend and platform roles) in 2026.
